# HR Greatly

> HR Greatly is a workforce management platform for attendance, leave, payroll, desk booking and support — all in one workspace.

HR Greatly helps modern teams run people operations from a single calm console: smart attendance with geo-fencing, one-tap leave approvals, tax-ready payroll, hybrid desk and meeting-room booking, and an end-to-end support ticketing system.
